### Eye colour

Optional `eyeColour: 'blue'` selects a fixed blue iris pigment. Omission, `null` or `'original'` retains the exact authored sample path. Other values are rejected before allocation. This choice is fixed for an Avatar and follows eye rebuilds; create a new Avatar to change it. Existing pupil, gaze, refraction, cornea and sclera responsibilities remain. Blue is a colour customization, not a calibrated or physical iris model.

`avatar.report().eyes` observes the requested/applied option, actual globe/cornea attachment, pigment vector and whether attachment and request match. A requested Blue that cannot construct eye shading fails instead of silently falling back. Original retains the existing raw-eye fallback. Showcase offers Original/Blue and Apply; Apply opens a fresh preview and resets orbit, motion and attention. JSON and named saved looks preserve Blue; Original is omitted. Export refuses a mismatched or detached custom eye owner.
